reviews.text: The office is lovely and the staff are so friendly. They treated my scared cat calmly enough for her to tolerate routine care without her usual aggression and we were on our way in only 30 minutes
Our pet rat terrier was very well taken care by the vet tech and the vet.
Organized, professional and compassionate. Short wait times and a comfortable waiting area all help to make the visit good.  The pricing is as expected, but they did give discounts when they could.
Thank you! 5-Stars means so much to us! Happy New Year!

I can’t recommend this hospital enough. Everyone I’ve interacted with has been kind, compassionate, and communicative whether in person or over the phone. Veterinarians are thorough in their examinations and are honest about what’s necessary and what can be postponed or skipped. Recently, I was in the waiting area with another client who was upset because their pet still hadn’t been seen 30 minutes past their appointment time. While I understand their frustration, I feel they were unnecessarily condescending and rude towards employees. However, Spring Creek staff remained professional, apologetic about the delay, and solution-oriented. It’s apparent these people care about what they do and about the wellbeing of your pets. Thank you 🩷🩷
Always greeted by name to include pet’s name.  Thoroughly explains everything.  I highly recommend this clinic- they really care.

We just moved to the area and looked for a veterinarian who would be a perfect fit for us and our puppy. Our tiny terrier needed to be spayed and Dr. Pacheco examined her during the new patient appointment, explained the procedure, answered all our questions, and scheduled the surgery. The day of surgery, the team kept us informed and let us know when the surgery was complete and that our girl did great. During pickup, we were given clear instructions and our girl, Pett, even received a certificate for bravery. We are certain this is a rare title with a very special few recipients. The team called the following day to confirm Pett was recovering well, and Dr. Pacheco called too. We have found the perfect fit in Spring Creek Animal Hospital!
Always a pleasure dealing with Spring Creek.

We’ve come to SC for 5 years. We have two dogs and one cat and they treat all of our pets with so much love. Everything is so thoughtful and caring. 10/10 1000 recommend this Clinic. Thank you so much for all you do for our babies

I have been going to Spring Creek Animal Hospital for about 5 years. I love the way the Doctors and the staff treat my dogs and me. They are kind and gentle with my dogs, even my nervous dog   loves to go see them. Spring Creek Animal Hospital is the best.
Very caring, patient and thorough staff.

Absolutely LOVE Spring Creek Animal hospital. Ever since my first visit with them, their team has always gone above and beyond to make sure my pup is given the attention, patience, and care he needs, while also making sure to answer and address any questions or concerns I've had as a pet owner. This team is truly a step above the rest.
I take both of my dogs here and have never had a bad experience with any of the staff.

I took my dog here for the first time and I plan on making  this place my regular Vet.
Right away I was greeted and all the staff was so very friendly.
The actual vet was very detailed and gave me the best advise without being pushy or giving me options I didn’t need.

Although Dr Youngblood is no longer at Spring Creek Animal Hospital,  she left a  well-skilled staff that is as efficient and courteous as they've always have been since the first time I went to their Vet Office back in 2002.  I recommend this Vet Office to all parents of FurBabbies to go and check it out for themselves. Just visit and you will find out what I"m saying is true. i didn't write the comments before this sentence, but it does mostly say what I thought my experience felt like. I do remember Dr.Youngblood, I hope she is doing fine in New Mexico, please say "Hi" to her for me if you are still in contact with her. And, I remember Dr. Pacheco's name but I did not remember her friendly face. I also remember you staff person by the name of Mack, if he is the same young man that I met when I  used to take Mickie my black lab to see Dr Youngblood and a young man by the name of Mack who see us first. If he is the same person that I saw on you website----I don't remember his face either, just the name. Well, I hope my registering my Corgi with your hospital will be a great experience for my Corgi and me in the future. Have a great week. Bye for now. Leo
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're excited to know you had a positive experience with our team!
Thank you for your 5-star rating Mr. Wallen, always a pleasure caring for your crew!
Appointment right on time. Dr. Carrasco was patient and kind with my dog.

Called the closest vet to me in a panic/emergency for my cat. Was able to get appointment same day thankfully. All staff were kind and understanding. Prices are fair. I expected more without having insurance. Got medicine same day and doctors were very informative. Will be back!
We've been taking our animals (dog and cats) here for years.  Our furry friends have always been given the best care with genuine concern from the staff.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us!

I brought my big, fat, old Tabby cat which is a task for me.  The staff came out to help me carry Sister Clara is so heavy.  The tech was so nice and patient as she asked more questions.  The Vet was so kind to Clara and she had plan options.  I want to thank everyone for helping Clara.
YHernandez

My dog was an active patient in this practice and recently seen for her routine check And vaccinations.  Yesterday, my dog groomer said that she had an infection and needed to see her vet since it was Friday afternoon going into the weekend. I promptly called Spring Creek animal Hospital for an emergency visit at 4:06 PM. I was told that they had no openings and she could not be seen until Monday.  Even though my dog was an active patient and recently seen in this practice, they would not schedule her. I was told that they were too busy and they would be closing soon. The website said the hours of operation were until 6:00 PM. I was told if I wanted her seen I needed to take her elsewhere.   I took her to a friend’s vet and found out that she had a double ear infection. I could not believe that I could not be seen, especially since they were still open

Very friendly understanding and kind ..
Most definitely will be my preferred hospital..my fur baby Mika is in good hands
Thank you

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us here at Spring Creek Animal Hospital!

I have 3 cats and 2 dogs and none of them fear having a visit at Spring Creek animal hospital (the dogs actually get excited).The staff is very thorough, informative, and efficient. Most of all they were compassionate when we've had to say goodbye to some of our most precious fury companions
The assisstants out front were very helpful and patience with my frustrations.

Our pup, Bexar, lost his appetite and became very withdrawn. We scheduled an appt but after seeing he was taking a turn for the worse, we called and Spring Creek made arrangements to see him right away. We took him in under the care of Dr. Martin. They ran some tests and took good care of Bexar the entire time he was there. Between Spring Creek and Thrive Pet Healtthcare, our pup spent about 3 days under care. Both facilities did a great job keeping us informed throughout the process and provided genuine care to our pup. Bexar was ultimately diagnosed with Addison's disease and remains in a fragile state. Thank you, Dr. Martin, Hollie, and the rest of the staff for your compassion and for giving Bexar a fighting chance.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us and look forward to continue caring for your pets for years to come!
All staff very helpful. Dr Martin was very professional

Extremely impressive by everyone here. The front desk personnel were extremely professional and extremely helpful. Everything was explained in a clear and concise manner. Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Amazing service across the board from start to finish. Dr. Martin is wonderful and made sure she explained everything clearly when discussing the causes of my dogs conditions and treatments possible. This location is also very fair priced - so glad we found this place and vet team.

my 15 month old has been suffering from allergies since he was a puppy and in the last 4 months it has been extremely worse with no resolution from my current vet, just doing the same treatments with no results. They were able to get us in very quickly.  They had great bedside manner and were attentive to all of my concerns with my puppy.  They agreed that the previous treatment was not benefiting our puppy and changed things up.  We went hope and not even 6 hours later our puppy was finally on the mend.  Not only was the rash almost completely gone, he was feeling so much better.  he was actually able to sleep without continuously waking up scratching and licking.  He woke up full of energy and ready to play.  They definately turned his frown updside down.  It has been a week and his skin has fully healed, he no longer smells, still no itching and constant licking, no more flakey skin and tons of energy.  It feels so good to be able to cuddle him and love on him again without him getting upset because he wasnt feeling well, Plus we are all able to now sleep through the night. I brought my dog, Oliver, to see Dr. Angie Pacheco at Spring Creek Animal Hospital on 3/17/21 for an oral surgery where he had 6 teeth removed and 1 oronasal fistula repaired. Oliver had several surgical tooth removals with different vets prior to this, with no complications. Before I got him, he had previously been used for backyard breeding and had not received proper dental care, which led to severe dental disease, rotting teeth, significant pain, and the formation of fistulas.
After the surgery on 3/17/21, Oliver returned for a technician appointment on 4/2/21, where he was cleared by the technician as healthy and normal. After that appointment, I personally observed him begin developing new symptoms, including pain and difficulty eating, increased thirst, rubbing his face on the floor, wheezing or heavy breathing, and snoring, all of which he had not previously exhibited.
I brought him back to Spring Creek Animal Hospital on 5/12/21 due to these symptoms and because he became unable to keep his tongue in his mouth. At that visit, I was told there were no abnormalities in his general condition and that he was fine. However, after speaking with Dr. Pacheco by phone, I was told that his surgical sites were not checked because she did not want to sedate him to examine the back of his mouth.
During that same visit, services were performed that I did not request and was not informed about beforehand, including a senior wellness check, a heartworm test, and rabies and DHPP vaccines. I only became aware of these after they were completed and I was charged for them. To my understanding, his vaccines and annual exam had last been done on 5/18/20, so I did not believe they were due yet on 5/12/21, and I had planned to have those done with a different veterinarian.
Because Oliver continued to show the same symptoms and appeared to be in significant pain and discomfort, I sought a second opinion at Texas Veterinary Hospital on 5/19/21 with Dr. Michael Mixon. At that visit, he was diagnosed with a sublingual mucocele and multiple oronasal fistulas in areas where teeth had been removed. Based on what I was told at that appointment, my understanding was that the mucocele may have developed during surgery if a gland or duct was affected, and that the fistulas were associated with improper healing at the tooth extraction sites.
I then contacted Dr. Pacheco to discuss Oliver’s condition and the findings from the second opinion. During that conversation, I was repeatedly told that there had not been a reason to check his surgical sites at the 5/12/21 visit. When I asked why his recent oral surgery, less than two months prior, was not considered a reason to examine those areas, I did not receive a more detailed explanation beyond being told there was no suspicion that his condition was related to the surgery. I was also told that the symptoms that she noted, such as weight loss and increased thirst, as well as the symptoms I reported, were not believed to be related to his mouth or prior procedure.
Based on my experience, I have serious concerns about the care Oliver received, or lack thereof, including the decision not to examine his surgical sites during his follow-up visit and the performance of services without my prior knowledge or consent.

Anytime we have needed to bring our pets to this facility we know we can trust that our pets will be treated well by the staff and veterinarians. When the time came to put our beloved dog down it was done in such a compassionate manner. I would highly recommend to friends and family to use Springcreek Animal Hospital for their pets care and medical needs.We have used them since 2001.

If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! The entire team has given me and my cats, Maleficent and Diablo, such amazing care over the years. I am truly sad I had to move away, because it is rare to find a vet team that truly cares like they do.

They exceeded any expectations I had, especially when Mal got very, very sick to the point of me almost losing her. Any and all questions I had were answered, and they even provided extra services at no cost to me like x-rays to ensure her feeding tube was still correctly placed. Any time I would bring her in, everyone from the front desk to the staff in the back genuinely wanted to see her and to know how she was doing. Diablo got the same level of care for his allergies, even though his situation was far less serious!

I never felt pressured to pay for services I didn't feel were necessary, and all of my options were always laid out and explained to me. I never left feeling like a bad pet parent. It was all reasonably priced as well, especially with my military discount.

If time, money, and distance weren't a factor, I would happily fly back to continue having my babies cared for by this amazing team. Dr. Pacheco and Dr. Carrasco... we thank you both from the very bottom of our hearts. Mal, Diablo, and I have safely arrived over seas, and we wouldn't be here without you. Thank you!!

They’re always so helpful and kind. Highly recommend! My dog is feeling much better after an ear infection and a skin rash flare up. I'm super grateful!

As soon as I arrived I was greeted and taken straight back.  The office manager, receptionist, assistant and doctor were just top tier and I can't thank them enough.

Let me start by saying this amazing animal care facility is definitely a five star experience for both you and your fur family members.  We rescued a cat and unfortunately were not aware of the issues that come with along with the process.  We took our new family member to a vet within the two weeks
Allotted by the animal rescue service. The service cost us over $200 without any vaccinations or medications to be filled. It was a check up. The staff was apathetic, offering no positive feedback. We then found Spring Creek animal Hospital, looking for a better fit for our fur baby. From the moment you walk in the door you will know that it is the place for you to bring your fur baby. The loving care you receive as a family starts at reception, flows through to the assistants,  right to the doctor. They listen to our concerns, offered solutions, and most importantly, treated our fur baby like his life and his being had value. The staff is not only kind, but they are also very empathetic and caring. I am so glad that we found this amazing staff and facility. A lot of of times when you have a fur baby that has become such a pivotal part of your family, There are places that take advantage of your love for your fur baby and your lack of knowledge. We have had it happen to us before at other places with other pets.  It is often reflected, in the treatment of your fur baby And the exorbitant prices, along with the suggestions of treatment after treatment with no true resolution. This is not that place, If you’re looking for a Veterinarian who will not only treat your pet, but sincerely, and truly cares for their well-being and yours, Spring Creek animal Hospital is where you should be.  Follow up phone calls, consultations with the doctors, getting appointments with ease and medication delivery made easy. Empathetic, Kind, caring, loving, and professional. A staff that gives 100% with every patient every day. I hope they know how much we appreciate them and the work they do and how well they do it.
